request: For the archive, the analysis coordinator wants two products from a single call: an edge-filtered network that can be opened without further processing, and the complete p-value evidence used for that filtering. There is no downstream script in the approved pipeline, and the coordinator explicitly disallows a separate filtering pass after the tool returns. All expression input checks have passed, including the minimum sample count and preprocessing declarations. The question is about the exact artifact combination produced by the registered workflow, rather than whether a programmer could build a new wrapper to achieve the same goal. Can BONOBO write already-thresholded networks and saved p-value matrices in the same upstream run, with no downstream thresholding?
